method: Renode M55 per-function equivalence. 18 DSP/float functions. inv_imu_*/TDK + filesystem + log callees run-stock/stubbed; hal_i2c modelled. g2_imu_* state placed+seeded; float-bearing structs (g2_imu_samples 0x8cc, g2_imu_mount_matrix, biquad, bias vectors) seeded with FINITE floats; g2_imu_samples.count bounded to 4 (<IMU_SAMPLE_SLOTS=20). Build uses -ffp-contract=off to match stock IAR non-fused vmla.f32 semantics.
result: 18/18 functions, 0 diffs, re-verified in chunks imufpA/B/C under the FINAL harness (gpio arity fix + VFP-aware arg-logging). Each chunk magic=complete.
harness_extensions_this_turn: tramp.S: trampoline table grown 64->192 (fp.c needs 76 stubs; >64 silently branched past the table -> INVSTATE lockup). autogen guards stubs>192.
autogen GLOBAL_SIZES: seed full struct extents (g2_imu_samples 0x8cc etc.) so pointer/float fields past the old 48B default are deterministic across both variant runs.
autogen FLOAT_SEED + harness ptr_to sentinel 0xFFFFFFFE: seed float-bearing globals with finite small floats so DSP results are compiler-stable (no NaN/Inf-payload divergence from garbage bits).
PRELOAD_WORDS prefix-match + imu count bound (g2_imu_samples.count=4) so sample loops terminate.
build2.sh: -ffp-contract=off so clang emits vmul+vadd (two roundings) matching stock vmla.f32, eliminating 1-7 ULP diffs.

ARGUMENT LOGGING (addresses parent/app-stream steering): stub_dispatch now logs each callee's declared arg count (via clang-AST declarations; 0=unknown->no check), compareg canonicalizes pointer args (stock MRAM 0x400000-0x800000 and C ITCM) so string/rodata placement doesn't false-diff while value-arg mutants are caught.

VFP-AWARE ARG LOGGING: scalar float/double params are passed in s0-s3 (hard-float AAPCS), not core r0-r3, so they are excluded from the core-register arg log. Before this, semantic_forward_periodic_sample false-diffed (0/10): it calls imu_accel_report_send_4da6d4(float,float,float) and the logged core regs held leftover sample pointers that differed stock-vs-C. With float params excluded it is 10/10. LIMITATION: float args to STUBBED callees are not value-compared (would require capturing s0-s3 in the asm stub). Float args to RUN-STOCK callees are fully exercised.
gpio_write_arity_finding: g2_codec_gpio_write @0x509024 is semantically (channel,value): disasm reads only r0,r1 for known channels; r2 is explicitly unused and r3 is only a default-case passthrough for UNKNOWN channels. imu passes channel 1 (known), so trailing regs are don't-care. KNOWN_NARGS pins its logged core args to 2, resolving benign trailing-arg false diffs.
